title: +*JAPANESE CULTURE I
description: Explores an introductory survey of Japanese history, mythology, folktales, poetry, arts, literature, society, theaters, the Tea ceremony, Ikebana, Japanese gardens, and traditions from ancient times to the mid-16th century. Taught in English.
recommendations: Take WLC 235, WLC 236, and WLC 237 in sequence
